scenes.text:
ELECTRONIC ANKLE MONITOR
RESTRICTS MAP ACCESS
scenes.ovoz: Look closely at the female protagonist's leg in artwork. An active ankle monitor strongly suggests story-driven regional map lockdowns.

scenes.text:
VIRAL SOCIAL MEDIA
INTEGRATED INTO GAMEPLAY
